creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`directed.toml` names its director role literally, so whoever convenes a directed council takes the name `director`. `muster msg join --name director` answered only "taking part as director (taken over from a session that had gone)", and the takeover kept that session's memberships. `muster msg who` then showed `director` in three groups left over from finished councils, whose posts would wake the new session. The convener left each by hand before making the new group.

Measured: muster 0.10.1, 2026-10-01, devenv, following the council skill's Convening section.

## Things that might be true

- **Have `join` list what it took over**: "... with its place in alpha+director, demo-council, <g>", so the convener knows to leave them.
- Or let a policy name its director by a group-scoped name, so a fresh council does not need the global name `director`.
- Have the council skill's Convening section say to check `muster msg who` after joining.
title: Joining as director silently keeps a gone session's groups
